intro.h2: Kitchens, Baths and the Rest of the House
paragraphs: DNA Construction 1 LLC offers kitchen remodeling in Harrison and specializes in kitchen and bathroom remodeling. Their listing adds home additions, flooring, painting, custom patios and decks and fencing, and sums it up in one line: if it can be upgraded, they can do it.

Reviewers say the crew arrives on time each day, pays close attention to detail and leaves the house cleaned up every evening. One family kept adding projects during a bathroom renovation because they were so happy with the work. Another says DNA Construction gives contractors a good name, even redoing a paint colour with a smile. A third simply loves her new kitchen.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens are one of DNA's two specialties. One homeowner wrote that their work is excellent, that they came on time every day and were detail oriented, and that she loves her new kitchen. Countertops are part of the kitchen work, so ask about tops along with layout.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathroom remodeling is the other specialty. During one bathroom renovation the homeowners were so pleased that they kept adding projects while the crew was there. Reviewers describe honest, very professional people who work closely with you to make sure every need is met.

items.name: Stairs, fireplaces and interior finishes
items.blurb: Photos from one customer's review show a staircase finished with black treads, white risers and iron balusters, and a fireplace surround faced in white marble-look stone under a dark wood mantel. The same customer praised the patience and detail shown in every room.

image.alt: Gas fireplace with a white marble-look stone surround and hearth under a dark stained wood mantel

items.name: Flooring and painting
items.blurb: Flooring and painting are listed services, and one reviewer describes the crew repainting a room in a new colour on request, always with a smile. Painting often goes hand in hand with a kitchen or bath remodel, so ask to add it to your quote.

items.name: Additions, decks and fencing
items.blurb: Their listing also covers home additions, custom patios and decks, fencing and much more. If you are planning a bigger project or outdoor work alongside a kitchen or bath, call to talk through the whole plan with one contractor.

about.text: DNA Construction 1 LLC is a family built and run remodeling company at 59 Washington St in Harrison, New Jersey. Kitchen and bathroom remodeling are its specialties, and it also takes on additions, flooring, painting, patios, decks and fencing. Customers describe a crew that shows up on time, pays attention to every detail and cleans up before leaving each day. The company holds a 5.0 rating from 10 Google reviews and keeps long hours, Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 8 PM.

process.h2: How a DNA Construction Project Runs

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call (551) 580-5040, Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 8 PM, and describe the kitchen, bath or other project.

steps.title: Plan together
steps.text: The team works closely with you to understand everything you need, as one reviewer described, before the work is scheduled.

steps.title: On-time work days
steps.text: The crew arrives on time each day and leaves the house cleaned up at the end of it, according to reviewers.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Walk through the finished work together. If something like a paint colour needs changing, reviewers say it is handled with a smile.

items.name: Lauren P.
items.text: DNA construction was wonderful to work with from start to finish. The team paid close attention to detail and worked closely with us to make sure all of our needs were met. They were honest and very professional. We kept adding on projects while they were doing our bathroom renovation because we were so happy with their work. We highly recommend DNA construction and look forward to using them again in the future!

items.name: rupaldalal
items.text: DNA Construction gives contractors a good name. They were detailed, completed the work on time, and were extremely professional (arriving on time each day, took pride in their work, making sure every detail was attended to, and left the house cleaned up each day.) They were also very patient and kind with minor disruptions caused by us (dog / kids / requesting redo of paint color in one of the rooms) - always with a smile. Couldn’t recommend them more highly.

items.name: Fahmida K.
items.text: I can’t say enough good things about them. They are very professional, detail oriented, came on time every day. Their work is excellent I love my new Kitchen. They made may dream come true. Highly recommended them for any home project.

service_area.text: DNA Construction 1 LLC is based at 59 Washington St in Harrison, New Jersey, according to Google, and works in customers' homes on kitchens, baths and more. No wider service area is published, so if you live outside Harrison, call (551) 580-5040 to ask whether your project is within reach. Long weekday and Saturday hours make it easy to find a time to talk.

items.a: DNA Construction 1 LLC is open Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 8 PM and closed on Sunday, according to Google. Those long hours make it easier to call (551) 580-5040 before or after your own work day to talk about a project.

BuildZoom lists New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor number 13VH12628700 for DNA Construction 1 LLC. You can confirm a registration with the New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs before signing. Ask for proof of insurance at the same time, since insurance details are not published.

Kitchen and bathroom remodeling. The company's listing also covers home additions, flooring, painting, custom patios and decks, fencing and more. Reviewers describe a bathroom renovation, a new kitchen and interior painting, so you can bundle more than one project into the same job.

items.q: Can I add projects once work has started?
items.a: One family did exactly that. They kept adding projects during their bathroom renovation because they were so happy with the work. Talk with the team about any added work and how it changes the schedule and the price before it begins.

Free estimates and financing are not mentioned on Google or the company's other listings, so ask when you call. Describe the room, what you want to change and your timing, and the team can tell you how they put together a price for your project.

final_cta.h2: Start Your Kitchen or Bath Project
final_cta.text: Call DNA Construction any day but Sunday, 7 AM to 8 PM.
